content: Sises oh Sakies
Sises eri ketilong oh ketiket kohla nan kahnimw en Seriko.
A ohl kepwehpwe men mie wasao, ede Sakies, me lapalap rehn sounrik daksis ko.
E iang songosong en kilangki mese Sises, a pwehki eh paliwar mwotomwot, iei me e sohte kak pwehki pokono.
Ih eri tangalahte mwohn pokono, doudahng nin tuhke pwoat me mi limwahn wasa me Sises pahn ketin keid ieo.
Ni Sises eh ketin lel wasao, e ahpw mahsendahlahte mahsanihada Sakies nan tuhkeo; e ahpw mahsanilahng, “Sakies, doudi mwadang, pwe rahnwet I pahn pas rehmw ni imwomwo.”
Sakies eri pitipitte doudihsang nan tuhkeo oh kasamwolong Sises nan imweo ni eh peren laud.
Aramas koaros me iang kilang met, re ahpw tapihada lipilipahnedki, ndinda, “Ohl menet iangehr pedolong nan imwen aramas dipan emen!”

Sakies eri uhda mwohn silangin Kaun-o oh patohwanohng, “Maing, komw mwahngih pwe I pahn kisekisehki me semwehmwe kan apalien ei kepwe kan; a ma mie emen me I pitihasang mehkot, I pahn kapwungohng ni uwe ieu me laudsang pak pahieu.”
Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Rahnwet komour me lelohngehr ni ihmw wet; pwe pil nein Eipraam aramas menet.
Pwe Nein-Aramas ketidohn rapahki oh komourala me salongalahr akan.”
Karasaras en Paunen Kohl Eisek
Ni aramas ako ar rongorong mahsen pwukat, Sises pil mahsanihong irail apwoat karasaras. E ketin kerenlahngehr Serusalem, oh aramas akan kin lemeleme me Wehin Koht nektehn pahn sansalda.
Ih eri mahsanih, “Ohl lapalap emen mie me seiloaklahng nan sahpw doh ehu pwe en kesepwildahng nanmwarki; e ahpw pahn ketin sapahldohng nan uhdake.

Eri, mwohn eh pahn ketin mwesel, e ahpw malipepene sapwellime ladu ehk oh ketikihong emenemen paunen kohl ehu, oh mahsanihong irail, ‘Kumwail kilang dahme kumwail kak wihnkihda sang ni mwohni pwukat, I lao pwurodo.’
Eri, aramas en sahpwo kin kailongki mehlel ohlo, iei me re kadarkihla mwuri meninkeder kei pwe re en kairehki duwen ar sohte pwungki en wiahla ar nanmwarki.
“Kedekedeo, ohlo ahpw wiahla nanmwarki oh sapahldo. E ahpw mwadang mahsanihong sapwellime ladu ehko, me e ketikihong mwohni ko, re en pwarala pwe e men mwahngih uwen mwohni me irail wihnkiher.
Me keieu pwarala mahs ahpw patohwanohng, ‘Maing, iet paunen kohl eisek me I wihnkiher sang ni me komw ketikihong ie.’
Ohlo ahpw mahsanihong, ‘Meid mwahu! Aramas lelepek men kowe. Eri, pwehki omw loalopwoat ni mehkot me tikitik, I pahn kihong uhk mwaren kaunen kahnimw eisek.’
Keriemen en laduwo ahpw pil leledo oh patohwanohng, ‘Maing, iet paunen kohl limau me I wihnkiher sang ni me komw ketikihong ie.’
A e mahsanihong, ‘Ke pahn ale mwaren kaunen kahnimw limau.’
Pil emen ladu pwarodo oh patohwanohng, ‘Maing, iet sapwellimomwi mwohni; I patohwan nekidala nan limwinpwudo wet.
Pwe I masak komwi, pwehki komwi ohl sakon emen. Komw kin ketikihsang me komw sohte kin ketikidi, oh kin dolungasang me komw sohte kin kamwarak.’
Ohlo ahpw mahsanihong, ‘Aramas mwersuwed men kowe! I pahn kadeingkinuhkada pein omw koasoi. Ke ese me ohl sakon emen ngehi, me kin ale me I sohte kin kihdi, oh kin dolung me I sohte kin kamwarak.
Eri, mehnda ke sohte kihdiong nei mwohni nan pangk, pwe en neitik; pwe ni ei pahn pwurodo, I en ale iangahki wah kan?’
Ih eri mahsanihong irail me iang mi wasao, ‘Kumwail kihsang mwohnio oh kihong me nah paun eiseko.’
A re patohwanohng, ‘Maing, mieier nah me paun eisek!’
A e ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, ‘Kumwail en ese pwe mehmen me ahneki mehkot, kalaudpe pahn pil kohieng; a me sohte naineki mehkot, pil mehkis me e naineki pahn pehdsang.
Eri, a duwen irail ko me ei imwintihti, me sohte men I en kaunirailda, kumwail kahreiraildo met oh kemeirailla mwohi!’”
En Sises eh Ketilong nan Serusalem ni Roson en Powehdi
Ni Sises eh ketin kaerala sapwellime mahsen pwukat, e ahpw ketin tiengla mwohrail ketiketlahng Serusalem.
Ni eh ketin kerenlahng Pedpeiti oh Pedani, limwahn dohl me adaneki Nahnahn Olip, e ketin poaronehla riemen sapwellime tohnpadahk ko,
mahsanih, “Kumwa kohwei nan kahnimwen. Ni amwa pahn pedolong, kumwa pahn kilangada ahs pwul men me wie sensel, me saikinte aramas emen dake. Kumwa lapwahda oh kahrehdo met.
A ma mehmen idek rehmwa, mehnda rehmwa ahso, kumwa sapengki me Mwohnsapwo me anahne.”
Ira eri kohla oh diarada soahng koaros nin duwen Sises eh mahsanihong ira.
Ni ara lapwalapwa ahs pwulo, aramas ekei me neirail ahso idek rehra, “Ser, mehnda kumwa lapwahda ahsen?”
Ira ahpw sapeng, nda, “Mwohnsapwo me ketin anahne.”
Ira eri kahredohng rehn Sises. Irail eri irepehkihdi powe arail likou kan oh sewese Sises en ketidahng powe.
Ni eh ketiket kohla, re perekihwei ar likou kan nanialo.

Ni eh karanih Serusalem, wasa me ahlo tangdilahng Nahnahn Olip, sapwellime tohnpadahk ko koaros tiakada koulen kaping pwoat ong Koht oh ngihl laud kapikapinga ih, pwehki manaman koaros me re iangehr udiahl, kokoulki,
“Koht en ketin kupwuramwahwih nanmwarki me ketiket kohdo ni mwaren Kaun-o! Popohl ong nanleng oh kaping ong Koht!”
Parisi kei me iang pokono ahpw patohwanohng Sises, “Sounpadahk, komw ketin angiangihada mahs sapwellimomwi tohnpadahk kan pwe re en nennenla.”
Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Kumwail en ese pwe ma re pahn nennenla, takai pwukat pahn uhd pein lokaiahda.”
Sises Tentenihrki Serusalem
Ni Sises eh ketin karanih Serusalem, ni eh mahsanihada kahnimwo, e ahpw tentenihrki,
oh mahsanih, “I ahpw men ke en dehdehki rahnwette, dahme uhdahn pahn kahrehiong uhk omw popohl! Ahpw met e rirsang mesomwen.
Pwe rahn ekei pahn kohdo, me omw imwintihti kan pahn keleiukpene, kapiluhkpene, koaitonuhkala sang ni pali koaros.
Re pahn karangkeiukediong nanpwel, iangahki noumw seri kan. Sohte ehu takai pahn luhwehdi pohn ehu, pwehki omw sohte dehdehki ahnsou me Koht ketidohn komouruhkala!”
Sises Ketilong nan Tehnpas Sarawio
Sises eri ketilong nan Tehnpas Sarawio oh tapihada angiangihieisang sounnetinet kei,
mahsanihong irail, “E ntingdier nan Pwuhk Sarawi me Koht mahsanih, ‘Imwei pahn adaneki imwen kapakap.’ A kumwail ahpw wiahkilahr deun lipirap ekei!”
Ih eri kin ketin padapadahk rahn koaros nan Tehnpas Sarawio. Samworo lapalap ako, sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko, oh kaunen aramas ako men kemehla Sises.
Re ahpw sohte kak diarada duwen ar pahn kapwaiada irair wet, pwe aramas koaros kin men rongorongete Sises, sohte men katihasang ehu sapwellime padahk kan.
